content.guideline_title: 2021 ESC Guidelines on cardiac pacing and cardiac resynchronization therapy
paragraphs: The ESC reviews relationships with industry and encourages transparency and ethical integrity.

It is mandatory for all experts involved in Guidelines development to comply with the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy. Under this policy, they are required to submit yearly Declaration of Interest (DOI) forms during the writing and reviewing phases of the Guidelines.

All DOIs are assessed prior to work commencing, and the ESC may decide to exclude any expert from a Guidelines activity based on the exclusion criteria as defined in the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy, Annex 3, as approved in July 2020.
The current policy and its annexes are available on the ESC website at www.escardio.org/DOI
content.note: No human genes are mentioned on this page.
